description: public.file-url from the macOS general pasteboard (2 items)
how: Created /private/tmp/rclip-capture/files/{alpha.txt,beta.txt}, opened that folder in Finder, selected both, Edit > Copy. Two NSPasteboardItems, one per file.
notes: Finder does not put a path URL on the pasteboard. It puts the opaque file:///.file/id=<volume id>.<file id> form, which only the file system can resolve - exactly the resolution a codec must never do. The numbers are an ephemeral volume id and an inode of a /private/tmp file; they are not a volume UUID and identify nothing outside this boot, so they are left as captured.
